Bill.BriefDescription: Modifying the route description of state route 513.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to state route number 513; and amending RCW47.17.695.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 47.17.695 and 1991 c 342 s 38 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A state highway to be known as state route number 513 isestablished as follows: Beginning at a junction with state route number 520 in Seattle,((thence)) then northerly ((and easterly)) to the vicinity of ((SandPoint)) Northeast Pacific Street.
